snippet.text: | `melian gate <#pr>` | Decides whether the pull request's head may merge into its base tip now, from the shared records on `melian/state` alone, under the base tip's policy, and writes nothing. It counts every round of the head whose base the base tip holds, takes each one's findings under the base tip's policy, every finding of a round of exactly the merge base to the head and, from any other round, only those on the merge's diff, and counts a check as covered only by a round of exactly the merge base to the head that stands as reviewed, and whose verifier ran when it named one, and a lens only when its record shows it ran at least at the floor the base tip sets for it. It reads nothing unless the base tip's root `melian.yaml` sets `trust.writers: true`. It refuses a head that is not a writer's, such as a fork's, since only a record the trusted host's pinned key signed would count for one, and no key is pinned yet. On standard error it names each counted round and what it covers, or why it covers nothing, each reason it cannot decide, and each finding a later round made live again with the `dismiss` command that clears it, then the command that starts a new round. It prints the merged verdict as `findings` does. A store's failure prints its code, never git's words | `0` may merge, `1` a finding blocks or awaits an answer, `2` the records do not review the merge, or it refused or failed |
